summary: A full parking-lot depot can need another collection before the scheduled pickup.
realLife: In 2023 testimony on Maine LD 1909, outgoing CLYNK CEO Alison Vanderhoof said some Maine drop depots filled repeatedly within a day and that bags went to a processing plant once capacity was reached.
gates: A depot reports it has filled its available space.
